content.thinking: הכותרת מדברת על "חשבון עובר ושב", כלומר עו"ש שלי, וכסף שיושב בו לא תמיד מקבל ריבית. בעמוד השני מופיע השאלה שלי: כמה עולה להשאיר כסף בעו"ש? לפי החישוב שם, 10,000 ₪ בעו"ש אחרי 10 שנים שווים בערך 8,203 ₪ בכסף של היום.

The bank-balance box shows 10,000, the savings-fund chart line is unclear to me, and the cost of keeping the money is shown as both 1,797 and 2,576, which I still need to reconcile. I'm going to check which of those figures is right next.
ההפקדות שלכם מגיעות ל-70,000 ונשארים לכם 62,681, ובעו"ש ריבית ניתנת רק על עד 10,000 ₪ (הגבוהה ביותר: 3%, בדיסקונט). אמשיך לעמוד הבא.

content.text:
"כמה זה עולה": "דמי חשבון קבועים... לפי התעריפון של הגורם המציע". No number. So the bank decides, and I don't learn here whether it takes too much.
"מיסוי". Tax on interest. Fine, and there's hardly any interest anyway.
That's enough. My eyes hurt, I'm stopping.

---

**What I'd tell my son:**

Listen, I decided one thing. Money that just sits in the עו"ש loses value. The page showed it simply: 10,000 ₪ left there for 10 years is worth 8,203 ₪ in today's money, 1,797 less. That number stays with me. And only 4 of the 8 banks give any interest on the עו"ש at all, and only on up to 10,000 ₪. The most is 3%, at Discount. So the savings shouldn't sit there. I'm fairly sure about that much. What to move it to, I'll ask you, or the bank. The thing they show next to it, "קרן כספית", I don't know what it is. Their 3.25% is "הנחה של האתר, לא הבטחה", so I won't touch it on my own.

What I read, in order: the heading "חשבון עובר ושב", then the part about the bank having to send a notice above 15,000 ₪, then "כמה עולה להשאיר כסף בעו"ש", the chart with the yellow and light lines, the 2% price rise, a second chart where 70,000 put in ends up as 62,681, the 4-of-8-banks line, "בפיקוח המפקח על הבנקים", and "כמה זה עולה". That last one only says "לפי התעריפון של הגורם המציע", with no amount. So I still don't know if my bank is taking too much. I stopped at the tax part, around the seventh screen.

What I didn't understand: "קרן כספית", "מק"מ", "BANK-35", "BANK-15", "מחושב", "הזנתם", the dotted underlines under the numbers. It also bothered me that first it said 1,797 less and then "המחיר של להשאיר 2,576 ₪". Which is it? And then suddenly 62,681 appeared, because they added 500 a month. I didn't put that in. The grey text under the charts was hard to read on the dark background. I didn't open the fold "חלק מהבנקים כן משלמים ריבית", or the "הצגה כטבלה". I didn't touch the slider, and I couldn't put my own amount in the box because these are just pictures.
